verdict.rationale: Figma publishes a documented REST API with an official OpenAPI 3.1 spec and TypeScript types (figma-docs-46, figma-probe-rt-3), a Plugin API for read/write access (figma-docs-8, figma-docs-32), an MCP server (verified live via runtime probe) and a Code Connect CLI verified to run keylessly, all enabling AI-native developers to build against official, machine-readable interfaces. Missing for 10: no first-party language-specific SDK packages beyond the TypeScript type definitions, and no independent third-party corroboration of SDK reliability/quality.
